sections.Profile:
The "Gladiator" pinball machine, manufactured by D. Gottlieb & Co. in January 1956, is an electromechanical game designed for two players. The machine features two flippers, four pop bumpers, two passive bumpers, two slingshots, two gobble holes, and two standup targets, with dual outlanes on both the left and right sides.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1956
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
